name: factsheet
pages: Cover — full-bleed photo, GCS symbol, bottom block: 74px title (italic second line), 28px subtitle, supporting paragraph

Factsheet — header, round flag + 46px title + subtitle, 4 dark key-figure tiles, Overview (left, 4fr) beside 6 Key Benefit icon cards (right, 6fr, 2x3), 4 Investment Option cards, 6-step Application Procedure, footer
Back cover — 'Our Global Presence.', country list, social icons, London address (static copy, no props)

country.note: page-2 header eyebrow (uppercased); falls back to coverTitleLine1 + coverTitleLine2

coverTitleLine1.note: Cover + page-2 title, first (upright) part, e.g. 'Italy'

flagIso2.note: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code for the round 44px flag on page 2 resolved by scripts/flags.py from the vendored msikma/country-flags set in assets/flags/ (atlas.png) (codes that set lacks, e.g. xk or gb-sct, are rejected). Omit only if the user wants no flag — the title then starts at the left margin.

year.note: Declared by the template but never rendered; accepted and ignored.

overview.note: Pre-line text: '\n\n' makes a blank line between paragraphs. HARD LIMIT: 18 lines in the box (about 560-600 chars as 3 short paragraphs) — the mapper throws above that. The template's own 4-paragraph demo copy is 19 lines and makes the box grow.

benefit1Desc.note: Template clamps to 2 lines (card width 160px) — keep to ~60 characters

fixedIcons.note: Hard-coded in the template, not props. Outlined Material Symbols, accent colour.

droppedProps.accentColor1: Flag-stripe accent colours from the template's data-props; never referenced by any rendered element.
